Cubusify · 21 October 2026

Website changes 2.0 completed

Applied all seven illustrated requests. FAQ sections, all 184 answers and the original image files are retained.

Validation

84 pages · 336 browser observations · no horizontal overflow · no browser script errors

Checked at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels. Confirmed that breadcrumbs, planning panels and the two mobile pause controls are absent. Reviewed the original text colors in light and dark themes, and checked that reduced-motion behavior still works.

Frontend build and all required frontend checks passed. The updated SEO report passes all 1,680 local implementation checks.

Local Chrome checks with fixed-width viewports and representative light/dark screenshots. The local SEO checklist does not measure organic traffic or rankings.

Document checklist

ScreenshotRequested changeImplemented
1 ✓Restore footer text color onlyRemoved the blanket gradient treatment. The footer title is white again, with its original cyan punctuation.
2 ✓Remove the planning panel wherever it appearsRemoved the “Plan your next step” resource panel from all parent and specialist service pages.
3 ✓Improve the Services directory and reduce text size slightlyReduced group headings to 22–28px and service-card titles to 17px, with natural wrapping. Other pages retain their existing font sizes.
4 ✓Remove breadcrumb navigation from every pageRemoved the shared breadcrumb component and its styling. No rendered breadcrumb navigation remains on any of the 84 routes.
5 ✓Remove the mobile “Pause scrolling” controlRemoved the mobile directory pause button. Continuous scrolling and reduced-motion behavior remain; the tablet and desktop carousel is unchanged.
6 ✓Remove the mobile “Pause reviews” controlRemoved the mobile testimonial pause button. The existing review cards and carousel behavior remain.
7 ✓Restore original heading text colors throughout the siteRemoved the newly added site-wide gradient override so each section uses its original theme colors. Existing font sizes, typography, section themes and layout fixes are retained except for the requested Services directory size adjustment.
